title: Engineering Mechanics
description: Forces, moments of forces, couples, resultants of force systems; distributed loads; hydrostatics; conditions of equilibrium and applications to particles and rigid bodies in two dimensions; analysis of statically determinate structures including beams, trusses and arches; bending moment and shear force diagrams; dry friction.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENGR 141, MECH 141, MECH 241, MECH 245.
